title: CPU rider audio (PR #444)
summary: Race CPUs now have engine voices, vocals, body impacts and chassis sounds instead of being silent.
details: CPU engines play through the other riders' voices (six nearest), each slot using the engine set the race sound table assigns, with that set's Min/Max ranges. The new audio::cpu module runs the player's sound decisions per CPU: Bang, Jostle, wreck and Fall vocals (gender from the roster), the body-impact latch, and landing, wreck and quad-to-quad chassis clips, with the 100ft vocal and 70ft chassis culls. Every sound is heard from the nearest listener, so split screen hears CPUs from the nearest view. Verification: cargo test audio:: (31) and engine_audio (7) pass, clippy is clean, and the browser tests test_engine_cpu_audio (2 CPU engine voices with stereo levels in an ENV01 race), test_engine_race and test_rust_audio pass. No screenshot applies.
limitation: No terrain or splash sounds for CPUs. Vocal, impact and chassis sounds are covered only by unit tests. Nothing was compared by listening. Room guests have no CPU sound. The 48-voice and priority budget is untraced.
